scientific_integrity: Prior work supplies the classical correspondence between idempotent Rota–Baxter operators and complementary subalgebras. The claim here is the complete isotropic-line parameterization and finite-field rank distribution for non-square-zero radical multiplication. No independent audit or novelty certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only idempotent weight-minus-one operators on the specified four-dimensional split local algebras with a nonzero symmetric binary multiplication form; no result about non-idempotent operators or nonreduced scheme structure. The classification is proved by algebra, with finite-field checks as corroboration.
title: Isotropic-line census of idempotent Rota–Baxter projections on short local algebras
